I set up the recurring post, but it isn't ready to run as you asked.

- **Schedule:** A cron job is saved to post a "Pod end of day" note to #strategic-pod on weekdays at 17:30. Its next run is shown as Mon 26 Oct at 17:30 UTC, not today (Wed 14 Oct) or tomorrow, so it does not start "today" as you asked. I haven't verified why the scheduler skips to the 26th.
- **Gateway:** The Hermes gateway isn't running, so the job won't fire until someone starts it. I can't start it from here.
- **Time zone:** The job appears to use UTC, not Chicago time, so 17:30 may be 17:30 UTC. This is an inference from the `+00:00` next-run timestamp.

I posted two messages in #strategic-pod to tell you this. The first contained a wrong line saying I would flag the gateway issue to whoever runs it; I can't do that, and the second message corrected it. Job ID: 7067b003727c. Cancel it with `cronjob_manage` if you don't want it.
